columns.name: FEEDBACK_REQ_ID
columns.description: Primary key of the Feedback Request table

columns.name: FEEDBACK_REQ_GROUP_ID
columns.description: Column stores common id for all requests generated for a user together in a single action

columns.name: FEEDBACK_REQ_TMPL_ID
columns.description: Foreign key to Feedback requests base table

columns.name: REQUESTED_FOR_PERSON_ID
columns.description: Person for whom Feedback is requested

columns.name: REQUESTED_FOR_ASSIGNMENT_ID
columns.description: Column stores assignment Id of the Requested For Person if available

columns.name: PARTICIPANT_PERSON_ID
columns.description: Person who will provide the feedback

columns.name: SHARE_WITH_MGR_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether to share the feedback with manager.

columns.name: SHARE_WITH_WKR_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether to share the feedback with worker.

columns.name: DUE_DATE
columns.description: Due date for the feedback requested

columns.name: DUE_DATE_ALERT_SENT
columns.description: Flag to check if notification was sent to feedback provider for completion before due date ends

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
